title: Unit Event — THE POWER OF UNITY — Episode5 Ungraspable Feelings

meta.Event Outline: As Akito repeatedly watches the video of RAD WEEKEND, he realizes that creating a certain "atmosphere" may be the key to surpassing the legend. Then, he hears that Len and the others are going to put on an event in SEKAI.

rows.Line: Studio

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot... Before we start, it'll probably be a good idea to discuss why we're meeting today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, if this were a normal event, I'm guessing we'd only be doing full runs as just rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we set this day aside to try things that might help us get closer to actually surpassing RAD WEEKEND through our event.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Get closer to surpassing RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
In simple terms...
We want to see if we can gel and create some synergy.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Synergy?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right. RAD WEEKEND became legendary partly because the teams there were all off the hook... But I don't think that's the whole story.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Every team was there to compete to become the best, which created this synergy that made them all better... I believe that atmosphere played a huge role.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why we want to use this event to see how we synergize as a group.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm inclined to agree with you there, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Truth be told, these sorts of no-holds-barred events are always fun to watch.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I never would've thought to take this kind of approach... I say it's worth giving a shot.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah! It sounds really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, let's do a run like it's the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Having EVER lead off definitely seems to be the right call. They have plenty of stage experience and shouldn't have much trouble warming up the crowd...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: A-Alright, I'm next...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you okay? You seem really nervous. Here, loosen up your shoulders and relax a little!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know!
Phew...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Mita's batting second.
I'm not really sure what he's capable of, but we'll just have to see...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Here we go!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, not bad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, he's come quite a long way.
If anything, he has plenty of power now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, I guess we don't have to worry about Mita.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks for listening!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's even imagining how to interact with the audience after he's finished singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, he's actually pretty good at getting a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Alright, next we have... This guy!!
Do not miss this moment!!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It looks like I have no choice but to throw down as well since you've gotten everyone this hyped up...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If we want everything to climax towards the end, this is where we need Tono to be.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (With his singing, we might just...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: He never misses a beat, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'm stunned...
So much power...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's become significantly better since that time we battled. Impressive...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, he's definitely got more power than usual. The crowd would probably be going nuts right now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No... Negativity's just gonna keep us from doing what we can do...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're up soon.
Let's go, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
We are headlining, so let's go knock their socks off!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
We're just going to have to find a way to raise the bar even higher.
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What?! They're even better than before...?!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: In such a short time too... I don't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I don't either.
However...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This isn't it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It isn't a matter of not having an actual crowd here or being at a different venue...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (At this rate, we're never gonna be like Ken and his team...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that's everyone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't say that I felt a lot of synergy, but I think we all did our best...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Right...
Even if we do manage to get the crowd going...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We still won't come anywhere close to RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We all sang like we meant it.
But... At this rate, it's gonna end up being “just another event”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are we missing...?
If only we had some kind of hint...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Is it me? Am I holding us back...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: No, Mita, you kept the energy up throughout your turn. What if we made Tono go first...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, Arata has the best skill and most power out of all of us, so we'd get a better start...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I still think our current order's the way to go. We've established a flow for pumping up the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I'm of the same opinion...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If we do plan on changing anything, it should be our song choices or how we bridge between them. For example, what if I switched out my song...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. It didn't go very well with Mita's song, so that may've hurt our vibe a little.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Mita's good at being an MC, so he should interact with the audience as much as possible at the end of his song. I'll try to sing something that goes with that flow.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, right... It's probably a good idea to come up with some good talking points to tie our songs together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, we should also rethink our song choice if we want it to go along with Tono's...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh...
Sorry, that's mine.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Hey, we're still practicing.
You need to keep that thing on silent.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I know. Again, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But... I also need to take this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Wait...!
We're not done...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
He's gone.
What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um... Why don't we give it another try once Tono gets back?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. It may also be good for us to choose songs from the genres that we heard during RAD WEEKEND as opposed to songs we're good at performing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we should try out a bunch of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
Alright, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not like he's singing badly or anything, but something's been off about him since coming back...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like he can't focus on his performance because something else is bothering him.)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, I'm exhausted!
We ended up singing the entire day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it feels like we haven't made any progress...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Things got a little better after Tono changed his song, but we didn't really get a good idea of how to produce the atmosphere from RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree...
How are we supposed to create that atmosphere...? What separates RAD WEEKEND from “other events”...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's late, so we should head home for today... But I'm gonna keep thinking about that after I get home!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Oh, why don't we ask Miku and the others about this tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good idea.
That might help us see things from a different perspective.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we'll meet up at MEIKO's place tomorrow and...! Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh... No, nothing's wrong.
Tomorrow at MEIKO's place, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
See you tomorrow.
Great work today, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! See you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can't stop thinking about it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We don't have much time left until our event. Right now, we have to figure out a way to get something close to that atmosphere, but...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But... I also need to take this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's been pretty cooperative, but something's still keeping him from focusing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What's going on with him...?)
